title: P7: spawn.py and mcp.py polish — hold when the claude CLI is missing, spawn tools refuse ids of the wrong role
spec:
Two gotchas from 2026-09-18/19.
1. orchestrator/spawn.py run_claude(): before Popen, check shutil.which('claude'); when None, return {'status': 'held', 'reason': 'claude CLI not found on PATH'} and log a run with outcome 'no_cli' so the daemon holds the task visibly instead of the worker thread dying with FileNotFoundError and the task being requeued as 'process died' forever (gotcha 2026-09-19). Also catch FileNotFoundError from Popen itself the same way.
2. orchestrator/mcp.py spawn tools: spawn_scout accepts roles scout and triage only; spawn_review accepts role review; spawn_spec_review accepts role spec_review (it currently runs an execute when handed an execute id, gotcha 2026-09-18); spawn_challenge accepts role challenge. A wrong role returns {'error': 'task T-x has role execute; this tool takes spec_review'} and runs nothing. Keep the tool signatures unchanged.
Tests: tests/test_spawn.py (monkeypatch shutil.which) and a new tests/test_mcp.py exercising the four tools with wrong-role tasks on a temp bus.
acceptance: tests/test_spawn.py::test_run_claude_holds_when_cli_missing passes and asserts no Popen call
tests/test_mcp.py::test_spawn_tools_refuse_wrong_role passes for all four spawn tools
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

result.summary:
Committed on `task/T-0208`. Summary:

**Files changed:**
- `orchestrator/spawn.py` — `run_claude()` now checks `shutil.which('claude')` before `Popen` and catches `FileNotFoundError` from `Popen` itself; both paths log a run with `outcome="no_cli"` and return `{"status": "held", "reason": "claude CLI not found on PATH"}` instead of letting the worker thread die.
- `orchestrator/mcp.py` — added `_wrong_role(task_id, *allowed)` helper; `spawn_scout`/`spawn_review`/`spawn_challenge`/`spawn_spec_review` each check the task's role before spawning, returning `{"error": "task T-x has role <role>; this tool takes <allowed>"}` and running nothing on mismatch. Tool signatures unchanged.
- `tests/test_spawn.py` — added `RunClaudeHoldsWhenCliMissing` covering the missing-CLI hold path (asserts no `Popen` call, `held` status, `no_cli` run log).
- `tests/test_mcp.py` (new) — `SpawnToolsRefuseWrongRole` and `WrongRoleHelper` exercise all four spawn tools against wrong- and right-role tasks on the temp bus.

**Test output:** `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh .` exits 0; full suite (`python3 -m unittest discover -q tests`) — 276 tests, all passing, no failures.

Nothing left outstanding on this task.
result.review: other account, different model; label PR same-family-review
